content:
**Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

Nestled into the mountains northwest of Berkeley Springs, this shack used to be operated by Toxic Larry, who prepared the meat of Brahmins, Cats, Mole Rats, Radroaches, Radstags, and Squirrels.

When a group of teenagers set up a campsite below his shack in early October 2077, [1] Toxic Larry considered them to be interfering with his hunt, and decided to take care of them. [2] 

The location is usually inhabited by three Snallygasters, and consists of a three-story wooden shack, an outhouse to the north of it, and a small campsite below the cliff to the southeast.

The building is a makeshift pre-War butchery, with a large sign on its wall advertising for people to "Eat Here." A pair of Radstag corpses hang in front of the entrance, and two Mole Rat corpses can be found around the side of the building in a refrigerator and a bathtub.

Inside, the first floor contains various forms of fuel including Gas Canisters, Fuel Tanks, and Woodpiles. Raw meat is in abundance around the area, including Cat Meat and Squirrel Bits in a fridge, and a pile of Mole Rat Meat on the floor. There is also a Cooking Station in the corner of this floor next to the fridge. A rickety staircase leads upstairs.

The second floor contains a broken bed frame, a Steamer Trunk, and a Mannequin wearing a pink dress. A Radio and some ammo sit on a dresser beside the bed frame. There is a Mothman poster hanging on one of the walls next to a locked Safe (Picklock 2). This floor opens out to a small balcony area with a barbecue grill and some steps that lead to the roof. There is a second Cooking Station on the roof. Next to the Cooking Station is a shelf that contains three Cat Meat and some Sugar and spices to cook with.

From the second floor, a small path leads north toward an outhouse, which has a wall Safe (Picklock 3), half buried in rubble.

The campsite consists of two derelict vehicles, a Pick-R-Up Truck and an Off-Road Vehicle, as well as two tents, and some benches around a campfire.

Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go appears in *Fallout 76*.
